title: Project list reads through the ProjectSummary helper
description: Refactor: the Projects page builds its rows with a new per-project summary helper. No visible change intended.

steps.text: Open Projects. Ten projects list their owner and open tasks.
Open Cedar Ridge Wind. Its five open tasks are listed.

verdict.why: The Projects page goes from 3 to 23 SQL queries: two per project (N+1), so it grows with the list.

questions.question: How many projects does the after Projects page list?
Does anything on screen differ between before and after?
Compared with before, how many SQL queries does loading the Projects page run after the change?
In the after version, does the number of SQL queries for the Projects page grow with the number of projects listed?
